title: Joseph Smith’s Revelations, Doctrine and Covenants 65
book: Joseph Smith's Revelations: A D&C Study Companion from the Joseph Smith Papers

footnotes.text: The New Testament records Christ telling Peter that he would receive “the keys of the kingdom of heaven.” A 15 March 1832 revelation declares that the Lord gave JS “the keys of the Kingdom.” Likewise, a history that JS composed circa summer 1832 states that JS also received “the Kees of the Kingdom of God.” (Matthew 16:19; Revelation, 15 Mar. 1832, inJSP,D2:208; JS History, ca. Summer 1832, inJSP,D2:280.)

About the same time as this revelation was dictated, JS revised Mark 8:38 to read, “He that layeth down his life for my sake & the Gospels, shall come with him, & shall be clothed with his glory, in the cloud, on the right hand of the son of man.” (New Testament Revision 2, part 2, p. 24 [Joseph Smith Translation, Mark 8:43]; see also Faulring et al.,Joseph Smith’s New Translation of the Bible,67.)
Revelation, 30 Oct. 1831, in William E. McLellin, Papers, CHL.
Faulring et al.,Joseph Smith’s New Translation of the Bible,64–67.

McLellin noted in his journal that he copied revelations during a three-week period between 29 October and 16 November. Whitmer made his copy before leaving for Missouri on 20 November. (McLellin, Journal, Oct.–Nov. 1831; Revelation, 30 Oct. 1831, in McLellin, Copies of Revelations, [8]; Whitmer, History, 38, inJSP,H2:49.)
John Whitmer assigned this number to the revelation when recording it in Revelation Book 1.
